tools.name: get_swap_quote
tools.description: Get the best swap route across DEX aggregator venues. Returns the winning venue quote plus every venue quote for transparency, and the fee recipient address (auditable against get_meta). Cross-chain quotes (e.g. USDT on Arbitrum -> USDC on Base) are supported on EVM.

tools.name: build_swap_transaction
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction for a quoted swap. Returns EVM fields (to/data/value) or a Solana base64 transaction, plus a verification block: routerAllowlisted, decodedSummary, minBuyAmount, approvalTarget. VERIFY BEFORE SIGNING — sign only if routerAllowlisted is true and the addresses match the p

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: OHLCV candles for a token (top pool by liquidity). Timeframes: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d.

tools.name: get_meta
tools.description: blueDEX's published transparency data: treasury (fee recipient) addresses, router allowlist, fee schedule, paused venues. Use this to audit quotes and transactions.

tools.name: list_instant_assets
tools.description: Assets reachable via the INSTANT lane (no on-chain DEX route) — Tron/USDT-TRC20, BTC, and stablecoin corridors. Returns ids (e.g. 'usdt-tron') to use with create_instant_shift.

tools.name: create_instant_shift
tools.description: Open an INSTANT shift for assets with no on-chain DEX route — Tron (USDT-TRC20, TRX), BTC, cross-chain. Returns a deposit address: send the `from` asset there and the `to` asset settles to your address. Custodial AT THE VENUE during the swap (~minutes); blueDEX never holds funds. Use list_instant_as

tools.name: get_instant_status
tools.description: Status of an instant shift by id (from create_instant_shift): waiting | pending | processing | settling | settled | refund* | expired, plus deposit/settle tx hashes once available.

tools.name: sweep_dust
tools.description: Consolidate many small leftover token balances (dust) into one token (default USDC) on an EVM chain. Pass the dust list (token address + amount — you know your own balances); returns a plan of unsigned swaps, gas-positive legs only, with the whole tiny sweep fee riding ONE leg. Non-custodial: approv

tools.name: list_onramps
tools.description: Reputable INDEPENDENT fiat->crypto on-ramps blueDEX signposts so a human principal can acquire a first coin with minimal KYC, then swap/bridge on blueDEX. blueDEX operates none of these and takes no custody; every ramp lands coins in the user's own wallet. Durable no-KYC = vouchers + non-custodial P

tools.name: plan_route
tools.description: Plan the cheapest MULTI-HOP route between ANY two assets — composes DEX swaps (non-custodial) + instant-lane bridges (custodial-at-venue) into one path, with every fee and per-leg custody disclosed. e.g. USDT on Tron -> XAUt on Ethereum becomes a USDT bridge + a DEX swap. `from`/`to` are an instant
